messages.done: The server is set up; the app is connecting to it.
messages.lead: For a fresh Debian 13 VPS (amd64, 2 GiB+ memory): the app signs in as root once with the password, installs Incus and an isolated container with vibechat-server (2 CPU, 4 GiB, 15 GiB; internet only to Cursor, npm, Bun and GitHub) and connects. About 10 minutes. The password is not stored.
messages.lockdownNote: At the end the server stops accepting SSH passwords, root included: add your own public key below to keep root access, or use your provider's web console later. If the app cannot confirm its own key login, password login comes back by itself after {minutes} min.
messages.problem.auth: The server did not accept the root password (or password login is already off).
messages.problem.bad_input: Check the address and the password.
messages.problem.host_key_changed: The server's SSH host key is not the one pinned before. If you reinstalled the server, forget it in the Server card first.
messages.problem.not_confirmed: The key login after turning off passwords was not confirmed; password login comes back by itself shortly, then run again.
messages.problem.step_failed: A step failed. Fix the cause and run again: finished steps are skipped.
messages.problem.unreachable: The server cannot be reached over SSH.
messages.problem.unsupported: This server is not supported: Debian 13 on amd64 is required.
messages.rootKey: Your public key for root (optional, one line: ssh-ed25519 AAAA…)
messages.step.connect: Sign in as root, pin the host key
messages.step.container: Create the container (2 CPU, 4 GiB, 15 GiB)
messages.step.egress: Limit internet access to Cursor, npm, Bun and GitHub
messages.step.lockdown: Turn off SSH password login (with automatic rollback)
messages.step.preflight: Check the system (Debian 13, amd64, memory, disk)
messages.step.token: Host token into this computer's keychain
messages.step.tunnel: Tunnel user for this app's key (port forwarding only)
messages.step.verify: Check the connection with this app's key
messages.title: Set up a new server
